CreateInstance111.keepImageLogin: Whether to use the preset password from the image. Default: false. true: use the preset password in the image; false: do not use it. 1. If true, password and keypairId must be empty. 2. Only supported for custom images or shared images.
CreateInstance111.bccCreateWithScript: Automation script executed when creating the BCC instance.
CreateInstance111.name: VM name (optional). By default no name is specified. If specified, for batch creation the name is used as a prefix and a suffix is appended by the backend in the form name{-sequence}. If not specified, it is auto-generated as {instance-8-char-random-string-sequence}. Note: random string uses 0-9a-z; the sequence increments according to the magnitude of count, e.g. count=100 increments 000-100, count=10 increments 00-10. Supports upper/lowercase letters, digits, Chinese characters, and -_/. special characters; must start with a letter; length 1-65.
CreateInstance111.cpuThreadConfig: Adjusts the number of threads per physical core (vCPU), essentially whether hyper-threading is enabled for each processor. Allowed values: 1, 2. Note: 1. By default, Baidu AI Cloud instances use the default value 2. 2. Only bare metal instance specs with Intel 7th gen or above, or AMD 3rd gen or above, support setting the CPU thread count.
CreateInstance111.numaConfig: Adjusts the CPU NUMA configuration, with different meanings per processor platform. 1. Intel platform: 0 disables NUMA, 1 enables NUMA. 2. AMD platform: mainly affects NPS (Nodes Per Socket), allowed values 0, 1, 2, 4, auto, corresponding to NPS0, NPS1, NPS2, NPS4, and auto. Note: 1. By default, Baidu AI Cloud instances enable NUMA optimization (Intel) / NPS1 (AMD), i.e. the default value 1. 2. Only bare metal instance specs with Intel 7th gen or above, or AMD 3rd gen or above, support setting NUMA options.
CreateInstance111.enableDeleteProtection: Whether to enable the deletion protection feature.
CreateInstance111.hostname: VM hostname (optional). By default no hostname is specified. If specified, for batch creation the hostname is used as a prefix and a suffix is appended by the backend in the form name{-sequence}. If not specified, it is auto-generated as {instance-8-char-random-string-sequence}. Note: random string uses 0-9a-z; the sequence increments according to the magnitude of count, e.g. count=100 increments 000-100, count=10 increments 00-10. Supports only lowercase letters, digits, and - . special characters; must start with a letter; special characters cannot be used consecutively; cannot start or end with a special character; length 2-64.
CreateInstance111.autoSeqSuffix: Whether to auto-generate ordered suffixes for name and hostname (optional). Yes: true, No: false.
CreateInstance111.isOpenHostnameDomain: Whether to auto-generate the hostname domain (optional). Yes: true, No: false.
CreateInstance111.adminPass: Administrator password to set for the instance, 8-32 characters, containing at least three of: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, special characters; allowed symbols are only ()`~!@#$%^&*-_+=\|{}[]:;'<>,.?/; the password must be transmitted encrypted.
CreateInstance111.keypairId: ID of the key pair to bind to the instance being created.
CreateInstance111.enableJumboFrame: Whether to enable Jumbo frames. Default: false. Enable: true, Disable: false. Note: only packages that support Jumbo frames can enable it.
CreateInstance111.userData: If the instance meets the restrictions for using instance custom data, you may pass UserData. Since the UserData you set is not encrypted when the API request is transmitted, it is recommended not to pass confidential information such as passwords and private keys in plaintext. If you must pass such data, it is recommended to encrypt it, then Base64-encode it before passing, and decrypt it the same way inside the instance.
CreateInstance111.deletionProtection: Instance release protection. Default 0 (disabled), 1 (enabled). When enabled, manual release of the VM is prohibited.
CreateInstance111.autoRenewTimeUnit: Required if auto-renewal is enabled; empty otherwise. Pay by month or by year: "month" for month, "year" for year.
CreateInstance111.autoRenewTime: Required if auto-renewal is enabled; empty otherwise. Auto-renewal duration: 1-9 for monthly, 1-5 for yearly.
CreateInstance111.hosteyeType: Host security type, effective when isOpenHostEye is true. "enterprise": enable enterprise-edition host security; "open" or not passed: enable basic-edition host security.
CreateInstance111.enableNuma: Controls whether to enable the NUMA optimization feature.
CreateInstance111.dataPartitionType: Data disk file format. Allowed values: xfs, ext4.
CreateInstance111.rootPartitionType: System disk file format. Allowed values: xfs, ext4.
CreateInstance111.cdsAutoRenew: [Deprecated; CDS auto-renewal is consistent with BCC] Whether CDS auto-renews. Yes: true, No: false.
CreateInstance111.createCdsList: List of CDS disks to create.
CreateInstance111.createCdsList.storageType: CDS disk storage type, including six cloud disk types: enhanced_ssd_pl0 [Enhanced SSD_PL0], enhanced_ssd_pl1 [Enhanced SSD_PL1], enhanced_ssd_pl2 [Enhanced SSD_PL2], enhanced_ssd_pl3 [Enhanced SSD_PL3], cloud_hp1 or premium_ssd [General-purpose SSD], and hp1 or ssd [High-performance cloud disk]; and one elastic ephemeral disk type: elastic_ephemeral_disk [Elastic Ephemeral Disk_Standard]. Default: hp1.
CreateInstance111.createCdsList.cdsSizeInGB: CDS disk capacity, must be an integer greater than 0, in GB, ranging from 0 to 5120 GB (create instance, create spot instance, query spot instance market price).
CreateInstance111.createCdsList.snapshotId: Snapshot ID. Valid when creating a disk from a snapshot; cannot be smaller than the snapshot size (create instance, create spot instance, query spot instance market price).
CreateInstance111.createCdsList.deleteWithInstance: Whether the disk is deleted along with the instance, effective when billing is pay-as-you-go postpaid. Initial value is false. For the V2 API, it takes effect only if cdsAttributeActive is set to true when releasing the instance (create instance).
CreateInstance111.createCdsList.deleteAutoSnapshot: Whether to delete automatic snapshots on release (create instance).
CreateInstance111.createCdsList.name: Disk name (create instance).
CreateInstance111.imageId: Image ID of the VM instance to create. You can obtain the required image ID by calling the query image list interface.
CreateInstance111.spec: Package spec of the VM instance to create, e.g. bcc.g7.c2m8. Use the instance package spec list interface to view available instance packages and specs.
CreateInstance111.bidModel: Spot instance bidding model. Market price: "market", Custom: "custom". See BidModel.
CreateInstance111.bidPrice: Spot instance bid amount, in CNY/minute. For a custom bid, if the bid amount is lower than the market price, creation is not allowed. Only effective when bidModel='custom'.
CreateInstance111.rootDiskSizeInGb: System disk size of the VM instance to create, in GB. Linux default is 20 GB, range [10, 2048] GB; Windows default is 40 GB, range [40, 2048] GB. Note: the specified system disk size must meet the minimum disk space requirement of the image used.
CreateInstance111.rootDiskExtraIo: Configures extra IO performance for the root disk.
CreateInstance111.rootDiskStorageType: System disk medium of the VM instance to create. Defaults to high-performance cloud disk (hp1). For specifiable system disk types, see StorageType.
CreateInstance111.networkCapacityInMbps: Public bandwidth, in Mbps. For prepaid EIPs and postpaid EIPs billed by bandwidth, standard BGP is limited to an integer from 1 to 500, enhanced BGP to an integer from 100 to 5000 (representing the bandwidth cap). For postpaid EIPs billed by traffic, standard BGP is limited to an integer from 1 to 200 (representing the allowed peak bandwidth traffic). 0 means no public IP is allocated. Default: 0 Mbps.
CreateInstance111.ehcClusterId: Optional parameter when creating a RoCE instance. If empty, the default EHC cluster is used.
CreateInstance111.purchaseCount: Number of VM instances to create (purchase) in batch, must be an integer greater than 0. Optional, defaults to 1.
CreateInstance111.purchaseMinCount: Minimum number of VM instances to create (purchase) in batch.
CreateInstance111.dedicatedHostId: Dedicated host ID. Specify this value when designating the VM placement location.
CreateInstance111.relationTag: Whether associated resources CDS (data disks), EIP, snapshots, and snapshot chains are tagged uniformly. Default: false.
CreateInstance111.fileSystems: List of CFS file systems to mount on the instance.
CreateInstance111.fileSystems.protocol: Protocol type of the CFS file system. Allowed values: nfs, smb.
CreateInstance111.ephemeralDisks: A DCC instance can create multiple local disks, requiring the disk type and size to be specified. Other BCC types can use at most one local disk with the default disk type, requiring the disk size to be specified. FPGA and GPU instances use one local disk by default, with the local disk size specified per the configuration.
CreateInstance111.ephemeralDisks.storageType: CDS disk storage type, including six cloud disk types: enhanced_ssd_pl0 [Enhanced SSD_PL0], enhanced_ssd_pl1 [Enhanced SSD_PL1], enhanced_ssd_pl2 [Enhanced SSD_PL2], enhanced_ssd_pl3 [Enhanced SSD_PL3], cloud_hp1 or premium_ssd [General-purpose SSD], and hp1 or ssd [High-performance cloud disk]; and one elastic ephemeral disk type: elastic_ephemeral_disk [Elastic Ephemeral Disk_Standard]. Default: hp1.
CreateInstance111.ephemeralDisks.sizeInGB: Disk size, in GB (create instance, create spot instance).
CreateInstance111.securityGroupId: Deprecated. Specifies securityGroup information; the default security group is used when empty.
CreateInstance111.securityGroupIds: List of securityGroup information to specify; the default security group is used when empty.
CreateInstance111.enterpriseSecurityGroupIds: List of enterprise security group information to specify. When not empty, securityGroupIds is ignored; when empty, the default security group is used.
CreateInstance111.subnetId: Specifies subnet information; the default subnet is used when empty.
CreateInstance111.deployId: Specifies the deployment set ID the instance belongs to.
CreateInstance111.deployIdList: Specifies the list of deployment set IDs the instance belongs to.
CreateInstance111.eniIds: List of short IDs of elastic network interfaces to mount. For batch creation, they are evenly distributed across instances by the number passed, so ensure the number of ENI IDs passed is an integer multiple of the number of instances, and the number of ENIs allocated to each instance does not exceed the maximum the instance can mount. Not currently supported for EBC bare metal instances. The maximum number of eniIds is 5000.
CreateInstance111.disableRootDiskSerial: Whether to hide the system disk SN when creating the instance. Default: false. true: hide, false: do not hide.
CreateInstance111.zoneName: Specifies zone information. You can query the list of availability zones by calling the query availability zone list interface. The zoneName naming convention is "country-region-zone sequence", lowercase, e.g. Beijing zone A is "cn-bj-a". Dedicated instances use the zone of the dedicated host and do not need to specify this field.
CreateInstance111.resGroupId: Specifies the resource group ID to bind the instance to.
CreateInstance111.isEipAutoRelatedDelete: Whether the postpaid EIP bound to the instance is automatically released along with the instance. Yes: true, No: false. Defaults to false if not passed. This parameter is effective only when the public bandwidth billing method is by bandwidth/traffic usage.
CreateInstance111.networkPurchaseType: EIP line type, including standard BGP (BGP) and enhanced BGP (BGP_S). Default: standard BGP.
CreateInstance111.instanceType: Type of the VM instance to create. For specific available types, see InstanceType. The default VM type is used when empty.
CreateInstance111.internetChargeType: Public bandwidth billing method. For optional parameters, see internetChargeType. If internetChargeType is not specified, the default billing method follows BCC: prepaid defaults to monthly/yearly subscription by bandwidth, postpaid defaults to billing by bandwidth usage.
CreateInstance111.eipName: Public IP name, 1-65 bytes, starting with a letter, may contain letters, digits, and -_/. characters. If this parameter is not passed, the service auto-generates the name.
CreateInstance111.isOpenHostEye: Whether to enable host security. true: enable, false: disable. Defaults to enabled if not passed.
CreateInstance111.enableHt: Whether to enable HT, used by EBC. Default: true. true: enable, false: disable.
CreateInstance111.billing.paymentTiming: Payment method, including Prepaid, Postpaid, and spot instance (bidding) (create instance, create spot instance, instance renewal).
CreateInstance111.billing.reservation: Reservation information. Not required when the payment method is postpaid; required when prepaid (create instance, create spot instance, instance renewal).
CreateInstance111.isOpenIpv6: Whether to enable IPv6 for the instance to create. Can be enabled only when both the image and subnet support IPv6. true: enable, false: disable. If not passed, it automatically adapts to the IPv6 support of the image and subnet.
